_readme: Primary: one NCT event page (URL still to be filled in). The Dyandra store-root targets are the off-by-default wide net. The Maroon 5 targets are left as they were. All times WIB. The monitor alerts with the real checkout link; checkout.py does the clicking and stops before paying.

targets.name: 🔥 NCT — event page
targets._note: PASTE THE EVENT PAGE URL into url and open_url, then set enabled true. Disabled with an empty url so the bot does not poll nothing and fill the log with errors. The domain this came from (dyandraglobalstore-03.com) is a numbered mirror of dyandraglobalstore.com and was never reachable to verify — check it against Dyandra's own announcement before trusting an alert from it, because the checkout driver types your name, email, phone and KTP number into whatever page it lands on.

rules._note: Fires when a real purchase path appears — /checkout, /cart, a midtrans/xendit gateway URL, or a new /event/ page. Static assets are excluded, so a redeploy that renames checkout-<hash>.js does not read as the sale opening.
Safety net: a 'coming soon' block turning into a product card, or any copy change the link rule would miss.

targets._checkout_note: Set true once checkout.steps is filled in and tested. The monitor then spawns checkout.py against the detected link the moment the sale opens, so the clicking is already done when you pick up the phone.

targets.name: DYANDRA STORE — canonical
targets._note: Store-root wide net. Off: you chose event-page targeting. Flip on to catch any Dyandra sale, not just this one.

rules._note: Same purchase-path detection as the mirror.
Safety net: a 'coming soon' block turning into a product card, or any copy change the link rule would miss.

targets.name: DYANDRA STORE -02 — spare mirror
targets._note: Sibling mirror, off. Only useful as part of the wide net.

rules._note: Same purchase-path detection as the mirror.
Safety net: a 'coming soon' block turning into a product card, or any copy change the link rule would miss.

targets.name: 🔥 MAROON 5 — official sale site
targets._note: PRIMARY. Right now the Artist Presale / BCA Presale / General On-Sale buttons are dead links (href=#). When a window opens they become real tiket.com queue links — that is the change this catches. Server-rendered, so the bot sees the real HTML.

rules._note: THE one that matters: a dead href=# button becoming a real tiket.com/queue URL. Alerts with the actual link, bypasses cooldown, and nags until you /ack. First poll only takes a baseline so existing footer links don't false-fire.
Safety net: catches a redesign or a copy change that the link detector would miss.

targets.name: MAROON 5 — tiket.com backup
targets._note: DISABLED — tiket.com returns 403 to datacenter IPs, and the page is JavaScript-rendered so the bot could never see button text anyway. The official sale site target is the real one. Leave this off.

targets.name: MAROON 5 — S.I.N. fan club signup
targets._note: Artist Presale on 26 Aug needs a code from this fan club. Watches the signup page in case tiers or availability change. Off by default — enable only if you join.

checkout._note: Steps for checkout.py. EMPTY ON PURPOSE — the store's real DOM was never reachable from here, so any selectors written now would be guesses. Run `python3 checkout.py inspect <url>` against the live page and build the list from what it prints. Actions: click, select, fill, fill_profile, wait_for, goto, screenshot, sleep. Each step takes selector or text, plus optional note/timeout/settle/optional. The driver halts before anything that looks like paying, whatever these steps say. Mark the entry steps "optional": true — the monitor hands over whatever URL it detected, which is often already several steps in, and an optional step that isn't there is skipped instead of stalling.

_example.note: BELI TIKET — optional: the detected link may already be past this
